decisions.diagnosis: Tube counter 161 was failing in its last two months before replacement: it undercounted both directions (East much more), and its speed readings shifted, a sign that the tube geometry had changed.
decisions.evidence: East/West daily ratio was 0.60-0.70 from May 2021 to Feb 2022, fell to about 0.40 (0.24-0.54) from 2022-03-28, and was back at 0.60-0.75 on the replacement counter 251 from 2022-05-29; West median speed fell from 28 to 22.6 km/h (Apr-May) while East rose to 19.5; weekly totals were about 800 W / 320 E, against 1300 W / 850 E on counter 251 in the next weeks and about 1400 / 900 on 161 in 2021.

decisions.diagnosis: The counter 161 fault probably started here, but counts may have been only mildly low and the very wet March 2022 weather also depressed riding.
decisions.evidence: West median speed dropped from about 27.5 to 24-25 km/h from 2022-03-12; the East/West ratio was 0.42-0.64, below the usual 0.60-0.70 but not yet at the later 0.40; weekly totals were 1245/660 and 1056/560.

series.name: Westbound (citybound)
series.evidence: Counter 251 (same RidePod model) replaced 161 the day after 161 stopped. The westbound direction has the AM peak (hour 8 is 26-42/h against about 5 eastbound) and a median speed of about 28 km/h on both counters. After a 2026-04-20 to 04-23 outage, the counter's direction labels were swapped: 508 took the AM peak (AM share of the 7-9h workday count went from 0.87 for 510 to 0.12), and the daily levels traded places (before, 508 about 450 and 510 about 650 on weekdays; after, 508 about 680 and 510 about 480). So from 2026-04-23 the westbound flow is under 508.

series.name: Eastbound
series.evidence: Eastbound has the PM peak (hour 17) and a median speed of about 17-19 km/h on both counters. Its share of the westbound level was 0.65 on 161 in 2021 and 0.65 on 251 in mid-2022, so the two counters read comparably. From 2026-04-23 the eastbound flow is under 510 because of the label swap: on the 04-23 afternoon after reinstallation, 510 had the PM peak (75 against 55 at 17h), and from 04-24 508 carried the AM peak.

summary: Moore Park Rd site 168 had tube counter 161 (2021-05 to 2022-05), then its replacement 251 (2022-05 onward). Counter 161 undercounted both directions, East most of all, for its last two months (set missing; the onset in mid-March is uncertain), and the two counters otherwise read comparably, so each direction is one series. After an outage on 2026-04-20 to 04-23, counter 251's direction labels were swapped (508 became westbound and 510 eastbound), which the series correct; the directional data is otherwise sound.
